description_en: Retrieves the daily bills for resellers and distributors. This feature is only available for resellers and distributors
description_zh:
获取分销商日账单。
此功能仅供针对Reseller和Distributor
name: GetDailyBill

parameters.help_en:
The type of the bill owner. Valid values:

1: reseller partner account 

2: reseller customer account
parameters.help_zh:
账单所属类型 取值范围:

1: 分销伙伴账号 

2: 分销客户账号
parameters.name: bill_owner

parameters.help_en:
The bill type. Valid values:

DailyOrder (deprecated)

DailyBill (deprecated)

DailyInstanceBill (deprecated) 
DailyInstanceBillV2
parameters.help_zh:
账单类型，取值范围:

DailyOrder(Deprecated)

DailyBill (Deprecated)

DailyInstanceBill (Deprecated) 
DailyInstanceBillV2
parameters.name: bill_type

Code.description_en:
The result code. Valid values:
200: OK.
1109: system error.
3050: The bill type can only be DailyOrder, DailyBill, or DailyInstanceBill. 
3049: The format of the consumption time is invalid.
3048: The bill owner can only be 1 or 2
Code.description_zh:
结果代码:
200 OK
1109 系统错误
3050: 账单类型只能是DailyOrder, DailyBill, DailyInstanceBill 
3049: 消费时间格式错误
3048: 账单所属只能是1 or 2

BillLinkCSV.description_en: The URL to download the CSV file. Use the HTTP protocol
BillLinkCSV.description_zh: 下载CSV文件地址，请使用HTTP协议

BillLinkXLSX.description_en: The URL to download the XLSX file. Use the HTTP protocol
BillLinkXLSX.description_zh: 下载XLSX文件地址，请使用HTTP协议

BillOwner.description_en: The bill owner type, which is the same as the BillOwner request parameter

BillType.description_en: The bill type, which is the same as the BillType request parameter

SpendingTime.description_en: The consumption time, which corresponds to the specific consumption date in the YYYYMMDD format
SpendingTime.description_zh: 消费时间，对应具体的消费日期，格式为 YYYYMMDD

Message.description_en: The message that corresponds to the Code parameter value

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求id，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Specifies whether the current API call is successful. This does not indicate the success of subsequent business operations. Valid values:
true: The API call is successful.
false: The API call fails
Success.description_zh: 候选值:True/False，代表了是否当前API调用本身是成功的。不代表后续 业务操作的成功
